rationale: The agent properly verified the user via full name + old ZIP before proceeding. It refused to update the address without the full new address, which is required to make a valid change, and did not perform any write without explicit confirmation. It correctly used tools to retrieve product data (cheapest T-shirt price and Bluetooth speaker/jigsaw puzzle details) and did not fabricate information. While the user’s address update and orders were not completed due to missing required info, the agent’s handling adhered to policy and provided accurate information where possible.
